platformDescription: This platform brings together walking and biking data for Santa Barbara County—helping communities explore safety, accessibility, and equity through maps and data insights. Descriptions here are drafts; we'll workshop the wording with the team.

tools.title: Data Query and Download
tools.description: Filter, explore, and download walking and biking data for your area of interest.

tools.title: Hotspot Finder
tools.description: Identify locations where walking and biking conflicts cluster across the county.

tools.title: Safety Trends Over Time
tools.description: Track how incident patterns change year to year and by road user type.

tools.title: Raw Data Query
tools.description: Explore count survey sites and time series for observed bike and pedestrian volumes.

tools.title: Modeled Estimates
tools.description: View modeled volume estimates across the network where counts are limited.

tools.title: Volume Trends Over Time
tools.description: Compare how walking and biking volumes shift across seasons and years.

tools.title: Bike Accessibility
tools.description: Rate how easy it is to reach points of interest via the bike network from selected locations.

tools.title: Infrastructure Equity
tools.description: Examine how bike and pedestrian infrastructure is distributed across communities.

tools.title: Safest Bike Route
tools.description: Map a recommended bike route from point A to point B with safety in mind.
